name: OnActorStreamIn
summary: This callback is called when an actor is streamed in by a player's client.

name: OnActorStreamOut
summary: This callback is called when an actor is streamed out by a player's client.

name: OnClientCheckResponse
summary: This callback is called when a SendClientCheck request comletes

name: OnDialogResponse
signature: forward OnDialogResponse(playerid, dialogid, response, listitem, inputtext[])
summary: This callback is called when a player responds to a dialog shown using ShowPlayerDialog by either clicking a button, pressing ENTER/ESC or double-clicking a list item (if using a list style dialog).

name: OnEnterExitModShop
summary: This callback is called when a player enters or exits a mod shop.

name: OnFilterScriptExit
summary: This callback is called when a filterscript is unloaded. It is only called inside the filterscript which is unloaded.

name: OnFilterScriptInit
summary: This callback is called when a filterscript is initialized (loaded). It is only called inside the filterscript which is starting.

name: OnGameModeExit
summary: This callback is called when a gamemode ends, either through 'gmx', the server being shut down, or GameModeExit.

name: OnGameModeInit
summary: This callback is triggered when the gamemode starts.

name: OnIncomingConnection
summary: This callback is called when an IP address attempts a connection to the server. To block incoming connections, use BlockIpAddress.

name: OnNPCGiveDamage
signature: forward OnNPCGiveDamage(npcid, damagedid, Float:amount, WEAPON:weaponid, bodypart)

name: OnNPCTakeDamage
signature: forward OnNPCTakeDamage(npcid, issuerid, Float:amount, WEAPON:weaponid, bodypart)

name: OnNPCWeaponShot
signature: forward OnNPCWeaponShot(npcid, WEAPON:weaponid, BULLET_HIT_TYPE:hittype, hitid, Float:fX, Float:fY, Float:fZ)
params: npcid, WEAPON:weaponid, BULLET_HIT_TYPE:hittype, hitid, Float:fX, Float:fY, Float:fZ

name: OnObjectMoved
summary: This callback is called when an object is moved after MoveObject (when it stops moving).

name: OnPickupStreamIn
summary: Called when a pickup enters the visual range of a player.

name: OnPickupStreamOut
summary: Called when a pickup leaves the visual range of a player.

name: OnPlayerClickGangZone
summary: This callback is called when a player clicked a gangzone.

name: OnPlayerClickMap
summary: OnPlayerClickMap is called when a player places a target/waypoint on the pause menu map (by right-clicking).

name: OnPlayerClickPlayer
summary: Called when a player double-clicks on a player on the scoreboard.

name: OnPlayerClickPlayerGangZone
summary: This callback is called when a player clicked a player gangzone.

name: OnPlayerClickPlayerTextDraw
summary: This callback is called when a player clicks on a player-textdraw. It is not called when player cancels the select mode (ESC) - however, OnPlayerClickTextDraw is.

name: OnPlayerClickTextDraw
summary: This callback is called when a player clicks on a textdraw or cancels the select mode with the Escape key.

name: OnPlayerCommandText
summary: This callback is called when a player enters a command into the client chat window. Commands are anything that start with a forward slash, e.g. /help.

name: OnPlayerConnect
summary: This callback is called when a player connects to the server.

name: OnPlayerDeath
summary: This callback is called when a player dies, either by suicide or by being killed by another player.

name: OnPlayerDisconnect
summary: This callback is called when a player disconnects from the server.

name: OnPlayerEditAttachedObject
signature: forward OnPlayerEditAttachedObject(playerid, EDIT_RESPONSE:response, index, modelid, boneid, Float:fOffsetX, Float:fOffsetY, Float:fOffsetZ, Float:fRotX, Float:fRotY, Float:fRotZ, Float:fScaleX, Float:fScaleY, Float:fScaleZ)
params: playerid, EDIT_RESPONSE:response, index, modelid, boneid, Float:fOffsetX, Float:fOffsetY, Float:fOffsetZ, Float:fRotX, Float:fRotY, Float:fRotZ, Float:fScaleX, Float:fScaleY, Float:fScaleZ
summary: This callback is called when a player ends attached object edition mode.

name: OnPlayerEditObject
signature: forward OnPlayerEditObject(playerid, playerobject, objectid, EDIT_RESPONSE:response, Float:fX, Float:fY, Float:fZ, Float:fRotX, Float:fRotY, Float:fRotZ)
params: playerid, playerobject, objectid, EDIT_RESPONSE:response, Float:fX, Float:fY, Float:fZ, Float:fRotX, Float:fRotY, Float:fRotZ
summary: This callback is called when a player finishes editing an object (EditObject/EditPlayerObject).

name: OnPlayerEnterCheckpoint
summary: This callback is called when a player enters the checkpoint set for that player.

name: OnPlayerEnterGangZone
summary: This callback is called when a player enters a gangzone.

name: OnPlayerEnterPlayerGangZone
summary: This callback is called when a player enters a player gangzone.

name: OnPlayerEnterRaceCheckpoint
summary: This callback is called when a player enters a race checkpoint.

name: OnPlayerEnterVehicle
summary: This callback is called when a player starts to enter a vehicle, meaning the player is not in vehicle yet at the time this callback is called.

name: OnPlayerExitedMenu
summary: Called when a player exits a menu.

name: OnPlayerExitVehicle
summary: This callback is called when a player starts to exit a vehicle.

name: OnPlayerFinishedDownloading
summary: This callback is called when a player finishes downloading custom models. For more information on how to add custom models to your server, see the release thread and this tutorial.

name: OnPlayerGiveDamage
signature: forward OnPlayerGiveDamage(playerid, damagedid, Float:amount, WEAPON:weaponid, bodypart)
summary: This callback is called when a player gives damage to another player.

name: OnPlayerGiveDamageActor
signature: forward OnPlayerGiveDamageActor(playerid, damaged_actorid, Float:amount, WEAPON:weaponid, bodypart)
summary: This callback is called when a player gives damage to an actor.

name: OnPlayerInteriorChange
summary: Called when a player changes interior. Can be triggered by SetPlayerInterior or when a player enter/exits a building.

name: OnPlayerKeyStateChange
summary: This callback is called when the state of any supported key is changed (pressed/released). Directional keys do not trigger OnPlayerKeyStateChange (up/down/left/right).

name: OnPlayerLeaveCheckpoint
summary: This callback is called when a player leaves the checkpoint set for them by SetPlayerCheckpoint. Only one checkpoint can be set at a time.

name: OnPlayerLeaveGangZone
summary: This callback is called when a player exited a gangzone.

name: OnPlayerLeavePlayerGangZone
summary: This callback is called when a player exited a player gangzone.

name: OnPlayerLeaveRaceCheckpoint
summary: This callback is called when a player leaves the race checkpoint.

name: OnPlayerObjectMoved
summary: This callback is called when a player object is moved after MovePlayerObject (when it stops moving).

name: OnPlayerPickUpPickup
summary: Called when a player picks up a pickup created with CreatePickup.

name: OnPlayerPickUpPlayerPickup
summary: Called when a player picks up a pickup created with CreatePlayerPickup.

name: OnPlayerPickupStreamIn
summary: Called when a pickup enters the visual range of a player.

name: OnPlayerPickupStreamOut
summary: Called when a pickup leaves the visual range of a player.

name: OnPlayerRequestClass
summary: Called when a player changes class at class selection (and when class selection first appears).

name: OnPlayerRequestSpawn
summary: Called when a player attempts to spawn via class selection either by pressing SHIFT or clicking the 'Spawn' button.

name: OnPlayerSelectedMenuRow
summary: This callback is called when a player selects an item from a menu (ShowMenuForPlayer).

name: OnPlayerSelectObject
signature: forward OnPlayerSelectObject(playerid, SELECT_OBJECT:type, objectid, modelid, Float:fX, Float:fY, Float:fZ)
params: playerid, SELECT_OBJECT:type, objectid, modelid, Float:fX, Float:fY, Float:fZ

name: OnPlayerSpawn
summary: This callback is called when a player spawns.(i.e. after caling SpawnPlayer function).

name: OnPlayerStateChange
summary: This callback is called when a player changes state. For example, when a player changes from being the driver of a vehicle to being on-foot.

name: OnPlayerStreamIn
summary: This callback is called when a player is streamed by some other player's client.

name: OnPlayerStreamOut
summary: This callback is called when a player is streamed out from some other player's client.

name: OnPlayerTakeDamage
signature: forward OnPlayerTakeDamage(playerid, issuerid, Float:amount, WEAPON:weaponid, bodypart)
summary: This callback is called when a player takes damage.

name: OnPlayerText
summary: Called when a player sends a chat message.

name: OnPlayerUpdate
summary: This callback is called every time a client/player updates the server with their status. It is often used to create custom callbacks for client updates that aren't actively tracked by the server, such as health or armor updates or players switching weapons.

name: OnPlayerWeaponShot
signature: forward OnPlayerWeaponShot(playerid, WEAPON:weaponid, BULLET_HIT_TYPE:hittype, hitid, Float:fX, Float:fY, Float:fZ)
params: playerid, WEAPON:weaponid, BULLET_HIT_TYPE:hittype, hitid, Float:fX, Float:fY, Float:fZ
summary: This callback is called when a player fires a shot from a weapon. Only bullet weapons are supported. Only passenger drive-by is supported (not driver drive-by, and not sea sparrow / hunter shots).

name: OnRconCommand
summary: This callback is called when a command is sent through the server console, remote RCON, or via the in-game "/rcon command".

name: OnRconLoginAttempt
summary: This callback is called when someone attempts to log in to RCON in-game; successful or not.

name: OnScriptLoadPlayer
summary: This callback is called for each connected player when a script is loaded.

name: OnScriptUnloadPlayer
summary: This callback is called for each connected player when a script is unloaded.

name: OnTrailerUpdate
summary: This callback is called when a player sent a trailer update.

name: OnUnoccupiedVehicleUpdate
signature: forward OnUnoccupiedVehicleUpdate(vehicleid, playerid, passenger_seat, Float:new_x, Float:new_y, Float:new_z, Float:vel_x, Float:vel_y, Float:vel_z)
params: vehicleid, playerid, passenger_seat, Float:new_x, Float:new_y, Float:new_z, Float:vel_x, Float:vel_y, Float:vel_z
summary: This callback is called when a player's client updates/syncs the position of a vehicle they're not driving. This can happen outside of the vehicle or when the player is a passenger of a vehicle that has no driver.

name: OnVehicleDamageStatusUpdate
summary: This callback is called when a vehicle element such as doors, tires, panels, or lights change their damage status.

name: OnVehicleDeath
summary: This callback is called when a vehicle is destroyed - either by exploding or becoming submerged in water.

name: OnVehicleMod
summary: This callback is called when a vehicle is modded.

name: OnVehiclePaintjob
summary: Called when a player previews a vehicle paintjob inside a mod shop. Watch out, this callback is not called when the player buys the paintjob.

name: OnVehicleRespray
summary: This callback is called when a player exits a mod shop, even if the colours weren't changed. Watch out, the name is ambiguous, Pay 'n' Spray shops don't call this callback.

name: OnVehicleSirenStateChange
summary: This callback is called when a vehicle's siren is toggled.

name: OnVehicleSpawn
summary: This callback is called when a vehicle respawns.

name: OnVehicleStreamIn
summary: Called when a vehicle is streamed to a player's client.

name: OnVehicleStreamOut
summary: This callback is called when a vehicle is streamed out for a player's client (it's so far away that they can't see it).

name: OnPlayerEditDynamicObject
signature: forward OnPlayerEditDynamicObject(playerid, STREAMER_TAG_OBJECT:objectid, response, Float:x, Float:y, Float:z, Float:rx, Float:ry, Float:rz)
params: playerid, STREAMER_TAG_OBJECT:objectid, response, Float:x, Float:y, Float:z, Float:rx, Float:ry, Float:rz

name: OnPlayerGiveDamageDynamicActor
signature: forward OnPlayerGiveDamageDynamicActor(playerid, STREAMER_TAG_ACTOR:actorid, Float:amount, weaponid, bodypart)

name: OnPlayerSelectDynamicObject
signature: forward OnPlayerSelectDynamicObject(playerid, STREAMER_TAG_OBJECT:objectid, modelid, Float:x, Float:y, Float:z)
params: playerid, STREAMER_TAG_OBJECT:objectid, modelid, Float:x, Float:y, Float:z

name: OnPlayerShootDynamicObject
signature: forward OnPlayerShootDynamicObject(playerid, weaponid, STREAMER_TAG_OBJECT:objectid, Float:x, Float:y, Float:z)
params: playerid, weaponid, STREAMER_TAG_OBJECT:objectid, Float:x, Float:y, Float:z

name: OnQueryError
signature: forward OnQueryError(errorid, const error[], const callback[], const query[], MySQL:handle)
params: errorid, const error[], const callback[], const query[], MySQL:handle

name: OnPlayerCommandPerformed
signature: forward OnPlayerCommandPerformed(playerid, cmd[], params[], result, flags)
